title: Not X, but When: Diagnosing a Mandarin LLM Writing Tic through Contextual Appropriateness
abstract: arXiv:2610.22249v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recurring expressions in model-written text are often treated as signatures of machine authorship, yet most of them serve legitimate functions. Whether such an expression is a tic depends on whether the model knows when it is called for. This judgment of appropriateness, central to communicative competence, remains largely unexamined for language models. We study it through the Mandarin corrective construction bushi X, ershi Y ("not X, but Y"). Drawing on Gricean pragmatics and corrective negation, we introduce a decision tree that classifies uses as substantive, optional, or defective by testing whether the context makes X a live alternative and whether rejecting X is informative. Five commercial models use the construction 2.5 to 9.2 times as densely as a human reference. Of 307 annotated uses, only 1.30% are defective while 52.8% are optional, that is, correct but unneeded, so models fall short in appropriateness far more often than i

translated_title: 不是X，而是何时：通过语境适切性诊断中文大语言模型的写作口癖
translated_abstract: 模型生成文本中反复出现的表达常被视为机器写作的标志性特征，但其中大多数表达本身具有正当的交际功能。某一表达是否构成“口癖”，取决于模型是否知道何时才需要使用它。这种对适切性的判断是交际能力的核心，但对语言模型而言却鲜有研究。我们通过汉语纠辞性构式“不是X，而是Y”来研究这一问题。借鉴格赖斯语用学与纠辞性否定的理论，我们提出一种决策树方法：通过检验语境是否使X成为活跃的备选项、以及否定X是否具有信息量，将用法分类为实质性、可选性或有缺陷三类。研究发现，五个商用模型使用该构式的密度达到人类参考语料的2.5至9.2倍。在307个标注用例中，仅有1.30%属于有缺陷的用法，而52.8%属于可选性用法，即语法正确但并不必要——这表明模型在适切性上的欠缺远多于在正确性上的欠缺。
tldr: 本文基于格赖斯语用学提出决策树分类方法，发现五个商用大语言模型过度密集地使用汉语“不是X，而是Y”纠辞性构式（达人类的2.5至9.2倍），且超过半数用法虽正确但不必要，揭示了模型的问题主要在于“不适切”而非“不正确”。
en_tdlr: Introducing a decision tree grounded in Gricean pragmatics, this paper shows that five commercial LLMs overuse the Mandarin corrective construction "bushi X, ershi Y" (not X, but Y) at 2.5–9.2 times human density, with over half of uses grammatically correct yet unnecessary—revealing that LLM writing tics stem primarily from failures of contextual appropriateness rather than outright errors.
